title: AI Analyst, BI
text:
Company Description

Job Description
Job Summary
We are looking for an experienced AI & BI Automation Technical Lead to design, enhance and scale AI-powered Business Intelligence automation solutions.
The role combines hands-on Microsoft Power Platform, Python, Azure and Generative AI engineering with technical ownership of BI automation, automated quality validation and report delivery capabilities. The individual will convert business and operational requirements into scalable, reliable and reusable technology solutions.
The successful candidate will work closely with global BI hubs, Technology teams, architects and business stakeholders to automate BI processes, improve report quality, reduce manual effort and increase delivery efficiency. This role requires a strong balance of technical depth, BI domain understanding, solution ownership and stakeholder engagement.
Key Responsibilities
1. AI and BI Automation Solution Ownership
Own the technical design, enhancement and ongoing evolution of AI-enabled BI automation capabilities.
Develop scalable solutions for report onboarding, scheduling, refresh, monitoring, quality validation and delivery.
Convert manual BI processes into reusable and configurable automation workflows.
Define and maintain the technical roadmap with BI, Technology and business stakeholders.
Evaluate AI and automation opportunities based on business value, feasibility, scalability and adoption potential.
Ensure solutions can support multiple regions, clients, report types and BI hubs.
2. Python and Application Engineering
Design and develop scalable, cloud-native applications using Python.
Build and maintain APIs, backend services and business-rule engines.
Develop reliable solutions using object-oriented programming, reusable components and established design patterns.
Perform automated data validation, missing-value detection, duplicate analysis, anomaly detection and variance analysis using Pandas, Polars or equivalent frameworks.
Develop integrations across BI reporting, automation, quality-control and delivery platforms.
Integrate Power Platform applications with Azure services, SQL Server, REST APIs, SharePoint, Microsoft Teams, Power BI and other enterprise systems.
Optimize applications for performance, reliability, maintainability and scalability.
3. Generative AI and Intelligent Automation
Develop and integrate enterprise Generative AI solutions using services such as Azure OpenAI, Llama, LangChain and vector search.
Build AI-enabled solutions using Azure AI Foundry, Azure AI Search, Microsoft Copilot Studio, AI Builder, custom prompts, agent flows and generative actions.
Apply Retrieval-Augmented Generation, prompt engineering and structured AI workflows to BI use cases.
Use AI to generate executive summaries, business insights, recommendations and exception explanations.
Design controls to validate AI-generated output before it is used in business processes.
Evaluate Small Language Models for cost-efficient or low-latency deployments.
Explore AI agents and intelligent workflows for report creation, quality validation, monitoring and operational support.
Apply deterministic validation wherever accuracy, traceability and repeatability are required.
4. BI Process and Quality Automation
Understand the complete BI report lifecycle, including requirement intake, report creation, refresh, validation, approval and delivery.
Automate repeatable activities across Excel-based reporting and other BI platforms.
Develop configurable quality rules for data checks, business validation and change detection.
Support report-level and worksheet-level checks such as blanks, duplicates, formula continuity, reporting periods, product or market changes and variance thresholds.
Design monitoring and exception-management capabilities that enable users to identify and resolve failures quickly.
Partner with BI subject-matter experts to convert business validation requirements into scalable technical rules.

title: SDK Engineer - Python
text:
About Supabase

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role

We're looking for a SDK Engineer - Python to join our SDK team and own how developers talk to Supabase from Python. You'll work closely with the rest of the SDK team, our Auth, Realtime, Storage, PostgREST, Functions, CLI and Docs teams, and the open-source community, helping us make the Python SDK a library Python developers genuinely enjoy using.

Python developers reach Supabase from backend services, data pipelines, notebooks, and a growing number of AI agents and agent frameworks. The Python SDK is how all of them talk to the platform: database queries, auth, storage, realtime and edge functions, in both sync and async flavors.

This is a library-authoring role, and the work happens in the open: public repos, public issue trackers, and API decisions whose consequences last for years. If you get satisfaction from a type checker that catches the bug before your users do, from an async client that cleans up after itself, and from an issue tracker that isn't a graveyard, you'll like it here.

This role is ideal for someone who thrives in async, fast-paced environments and is excited about building developer tools that scale to millions.

What You'll Be Responsible For

Build and evolve our Python SDK across database, auth, storage, realtime and functions, with both sync and async APIs that feel natural in Python.

Start new things. Alongside the maintenance work, find what's missing, make the case for it, and build it. Nobody will hand you the list.

Work in the open. Triage inbound issues, review and shepherd outside contributions, keep CI and release automation healthy, and hold a clear, kind line on scope.

Own the typing experience. Make the SDK fully typed and checker-friendly, so autocomplete and static analysis stay correct in real codebases.

Keep us honest across environments. Multiple Python versions, sync and async frameworks, workers, serverless and notebooks — with dependency ranges that don't fight our users' projects. Test it, don't assume it.

Work on realtime. Long-lived websocket connections, reconnection, and subscription and presence semantics.

Track the platform. When auth, realtime, storage, postgrest or edge functions ship a change, make sure the SDK reflects it, and that we say so in the changelog.

Design in public. Write the RFCs, migration guides, release notes and docs. Treat a breaking change as a deprecation path plus a migration story, not a version bump.

Make our SDK legible to AI coding agents, which are now a major consumer of it.

You Might Be a Good Fit If You

Know modern Python typing deeply. You use generics, protocols, overloads and TypedDict as design tools, run strict type checking, and fix type errors without reaching for Any.

Have authored or maintained a published library with a public API and users outside your own company. You know what it costs to change something people depend on.

Know the maintainer side of open source. Issue triage at volume, reviewing outside PRs, release automation, changelogs and semver, security reports, and saying no to a feature request without losing the person who asked.

Are fluent in asyncio and have opinions on how a library should serve both sync and async callers.

Know Python packaging for libraries: pyproject.toml, wheels, modern tooling, version support policy, and why libraries shouldn't pin their dependencies tightly.

Test as a habit: unit, type-level and end-to-end against a real stack. Every fix comes with a regression test.

Write well. Design docs, changelogs and issue replies are a large part of the output here, much of it public, and we're async by default.

Have real autonomy: you find the important work, scope it, ship it, and say what you

title: Full-Stack Developer
text:
About The Opportunity

Netrix Global is looking for a client-facing Full-Stack Developer to build secure enterprise web experiences, backend APIs, and cloud-hosted applications that support Microsoft, AI, and business platform solutions.

The developer will use C#/.NET, React, JavaScript/TypeScript, SQL, and Azure services to deliver custom-code capabilities that are not suited to low-code platforms alone. The role includes identity integration, API design, testing, deployment readiness, and production troubleshooting.

The ideal candidate takes end-to-end ownership, communicates confidently with clients, and collaborates across AI, Power Platform, Microsoft 365, and DevOps teams. Success in this role means delivering secure, tested, and responsive applications with maintainable architecture and clear operational visibility.

How You Will Make An Impact  

Participate in client discovery and translate functional and non-functional requirements into practical technical designs.

Develop responsive React-based user experiences and C#/.NET backend services and APIs.

Implement secure authentication and authorization using Entra ID, OAuth, and role-based access patterns.

Integrate Microsoft services, enterprise systems, databases, and external APIs.

Design SQL data access patterns and maintain clear API contracts, error handling, and validation.

Write unit and integration tests; participate in peer reviews and maintain clean, supportable code.

Deploy and operate applications on Azure using App Service, Functions, Storage, Key Vault, and Application Insights as appropriate.

Support CI/CD, release troubleshooting, observability, and root-cause analysis with the DevOps and Test teams.

Explain architecture trade-offs, estimate delivery efforts, prototype rapidly, and document technical decisions and handoff guidance.

What You Will Bring To The Table 

We are looking for a professional who combines technical ownership with strong client partnership. Success in this role requires curiosity, accountability, practical judgment, and the ability to move work forward while keeping stakeholders informed.

Communicate clearly with clients and internal stakeholders during discovery, delivery updates, risk discussions, and project handoffs.

Take ownership of outcomes, follow work through to completion, and escalate risks early with supporting evidence.

Use documentation, experimentation, and collaboration to solve unfamiliar problems rather than waiting for step-by-step direction.

Adapt to evolving technologies, priorities, and responsibilities while maintaining quality and security standards.

Contribute to a supportive engineering culture through peer reviews, knowledge sharing, and professional client interactions.

Qualifications

4-6 years of relevant professional experience.

Strong hands-on experience with C#/.NET, React, JavaScript/TypeScript, HTML/CSS, REST APIs, and SQL.

Solid understanding of authentication and authorization, Entra ID/OAuth, Git, unit testing, Azure development, and secure coding practices.

Strong debugging skills, end-to-end ownership, clean-code discipline, and peer-review practices.

Ability to lead client-facing technical discussions, decompose requirements, estimate work efforts, and communicate architecture trade-offs.

Experience with .NET, .NET Core, Microsoft Graph, Azure Functions, App Service, Storage, Key Vault, and Application Insights.

Experience with Azure DevOps and CI/CD; familiarity with Jest, React Testing Library, and SPFx fundamentals.

Exposure to Azure OpenAI integration, Next.js, Python, Copilot extensibility, Docker, or Dataverse integration.

Secure, tested, and responsive applications and APIs.

Reliable identity and enterprise-system integrations.

Maintainable custom-code foundations for AI agents, Microsoft 365 (M365), and Power Platform solutions.

Clear monitoring, documentation, and operational handoff.

title: Software Engineer (Electron.js)
text:
Job Title: Software Engineer (Electron.js)
Job Type: Full-time
Location: Remote

The Role
We’re building high-fidelity productivity infrastructure for a globally distributed workforce—software that operates quietly, reliably, and intelligently in the background. As a Software Engineer focused on desktop systems, you’ll help design and scale a cross-platform time intelligence application (MacOS + Windows) used daily by thousands of professionals.
What You’ll Work On

Architect and evolve a cross-platform desktop agent using Electron.js, optimized for performance and minimal resource footprint.

Build real-time timekeeping systems with precise event tracking and background execution.

Design and implement system-level signal collection (keyboard, mouse, app usage) with strong privacy and efficiency guarantees.

Develop offline-first data pipelines with reliable background sync and conflict resolution.

Integrate with distributed backend services and internal APIs to enable analytics and reporting.

Continuously improve runtime performance, memory efficiency, and fault tolerance.

Collaborate with product, design, and backend teams to ship features that directly impact user productivity.

What We're Looking For

3+ years building production-grade desktop applications with Electron.js.

Strong proficiency in JavaScript/TypeScript and Node.js.

Experience designing cross-platform systems (MacOS + Windows) with consistent behavior.

Hands-on work with real-time tracking, event streams, or activity monitoring systems.

Familiarity with OS-level APIs for capturing user/system interactions.

Deep understanding of performance optimization in desktop environments.

Strong debugging skills and ability to reason about edge cases in distributed/offline systems.

Preferred

Experience building productivity, monitoring, or telemetry-driven applications.

Knowledge of native OS integrations (permissions, background processes, system hooks).

Understanding of security and privacy considerations in user activity tracking.

Familiarity with auto-update systems and release management in Electron.
